mechanism_narrative: A quarterly increase in GDP (GDPC1) above 3% annualized rate signals strengthening economic growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60-day returns in > 50% of quarters with GDPC1 growth above 3% annualized.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS < 0.5%) signals accommodative monetary policy, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window with FEDFUNDS < 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 6% signals a tightening labor market, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days due to potential inflation concerns.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5-day returns in > 60% of instances with UNRATE below 6%.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in housing starts (HOUST) above 900,000 units, combined with a rise in retail sales (RSAFS) above 430,000 million, signals strong consumer demand, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward correlation between HOUST, RSAFS, and SPX returns falls below 0.2 over any 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Always-on: a high industrial production index (INDPRO) above 100 signals strong supply chains, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60-day returns in > 40% of months with INDPRO above 100.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in CPI (CPIAUCSL) above 240, combined with a federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) below 1%, signals a potential monetary policy mismatch, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward correlation between CPIAUCSL, FEDFUNDS, and SPX returns falls below -0.1 over any 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained low payroll employment (PAYEMS) growth rate below 100,000/month signals a weakening labor market, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5-day returns in > 55% of instances with PAYEMS growth below 100,000/mo.

mechanism_narrative: Always-on: a high GDP (GDPC1) above 15,500 billion, combined with a low unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 7%, signals strong economic fundamentals, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward correlation between GDPC1, UNRATE, and SPX returns falls below 0.25 over any 1.5-year rolling window.
